summary: Mountain biker on Emerald Mountain (Morning Gloria trail) briefly lost consciousness and had chest pain, reported by an off-duty Classic Air flight nurse; RCSAR wheeled him up the trail to a side-by-side and on to Prayer Flag Meadow, where a Classic Air helicopter landed and loaded him
responding_agency: Routt County Search and Rescue + Classic Air Medical + Steamboat Springs Fire Rescue
